title: Category Cannibalization
scenario: Detect when a new article release in a category causes a > 40% drop in views for existing articles in that same category within 48 hours.
tableSchema: articles (article_id INT, category_id INT, publish_date DATE), page_views (article_id INT, view_date DATE, views_count INT)
hint: Use a lateral join to find the release event, then compare view aggregates.
correctQuery: SELECT a1.category_id, a1.article_id FROM articles a1 JOIN articles a2 ON a1.category_id = a2.category_id AND a2.publish_date BETWEEN a1.publish_date AND a1.publish_date + INTERVAL '2 days' WHERE a1.article_id != a2.article_id GROUP BY a1.category_id, a1.article_id HAVING SUM(a2.views_count) < 0.6 * SUM(a1.views_count);
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE articles (article_id INT, category_id INT, publish_date DATE); CREATE TABLE page_views (article_id INT, view_date DATE, views_count INT);
